title: A sample arrived damaged
summary: A preservation-first response for documenting damage, separating transit issues from workmanship issues and protecting the review trail.
contentNotice: Demonstration playbook for interface validation. It is not final MOSCATELLI policy and must be reviewed before operational use.
scenario: Use this when a physical sample arrives with visible damage, deformation, contamination, missing components or packaging failure that could distort the product review.
immediateAction: Do not repair, clean or alter the sample before documenting its received condition.
Photograph the outer packaging, labels, internal protection and damage in a consistent sequence.
Separate what appears to be transit damage from any possible construction or quality issue; do not assume the cause.

whoToInform.when: Immediately after the received condition is documented.
After evidence is complete and the issue can be described neutrally.

whatToRecord: Whether review can continue or needs replacement
escalationConditions: The damage prevents meaningful fit, construction or material review.
There is repeated damage across more than one shipment or sample.
A quality dispute begins or replacement timing affects a launch milestone.

templatesResources.label: Damage evidence sequence
templatesResources.text: Outer package → shipping label → internal protection → full sample → close-up damage → scale/reference image.
